claim.title: Exact trace update when adding one sample (Claim 3)
claim.statement: Let X in R^{n x d} and x in R^d be the (n+1)th sample, and X_{n+1}=[X; x^T]. Then Tr((X_{n+1} X_{n+1}^T)^{-1}) = Tr((XX^T)^{-1}) + (1+||(X^T)^dagger x||^2)/||Proj_{X^perp}(x)||^2.
claim.test_plan: For many random instances with d=1000 and n<d (e.g., n=100,300,500,700,900), generate X and a new vector x~N(0,I_d). Compute the left-hand side and the right-hand side of the identity using stable linear algebra (pseudoinverses and orthogonal projectors). Verify equality.
claim.success_criterion: For every tested instance, the relative difference between the left-hand side and the right-hand side is below 1e-8 (numerical precision).
